title: The Void Is Coming for You
topic: Deep Space Terrors: Rogue black holes drifting silently across galaxies
script: Imagine waking up to nothingness. No stars, no planets, just an endless expanse of emptiness. That's what awaits us if rogue black holes continue to drift through the galaxy. These cosmic monsters are invisible, yet they're slowly consuming entire galaxies. Their pull is so weak that we can't even feel their presence. But what if they're not just voids, but doorways to another dimension? What if we're not just observing the black holes, but being observed by them? Are we already trapped in an infinite loop of space and time?
